claim_text: Amazon Quick Suite is now generally available, giving business users one agentic workspace for research, business intelligence and workflow automation.
Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 4.5 is now available in Amazon Bedrock, supporting long-running agent tasks and complex coding workloads for enterprise builders.
Starting 15 July 2025 new AWS customers receive $100 in AWS Free Tier credits at sign-up and can earn up to $100 more by exploring key services.
Amazon S3 Vectors is now generally available in all commercial AWS Regions, offering native vector storage and similarity query support for AI workloads.
AWS Lambda is raising the maximum function timeout from 15 minutes to 60 minutes for all runtimes, rolling out to every Region before re:Invent 2025.
